verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's Marketing API documents the core building blocks an agent would need — creating/reading audience contacts, sending campaigns, and account-level reporting/export — and its help docs describe open/click-rate reporting for campaigns. However, the evidence never explicitly surfaces an automations API endpoint or a consolidated 'program health' reporting endpoint, so a full 'pull the whole program and report on what's working' workflow is only partially evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit automations-API documentation, a dedicated campaign-performance/report API endpoint, and any third-party/agent proof that this end-to-end pull-and-report workflow has been executed successfully.
